Class Operation

java.lang.Object
parking.Operation
public class Operation extends Object
Operation class that is the user interface of the Parking Management System. It reads the command lines entered on the terminal, processes each command, and displays the results until the Q command is entered.

    • processCommand

      private void processCommand(String command, StringTokenizer tokens)
      Process a single command with its data tokens.
      Parameters:

    • hasTokens

      private boolean hasTokens(StringTokenizer tokens, int count)
      Check if the command line has enough data tokens left. An error message is displayed if tokens are missing.
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens of the command line.
      count - the number of tokens required.
      Returns:
      true if there are enough tokens; false otherwise.

    • isValidPlate

      private boolean isValidPlate(Vehicle vehicle, String plate)
      Check if a license plate is in a valid format. An error message is displayed if the plate is not valid.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle holding the license plate.
      plate - the license plate as entered by the user.
      Returns:
      true if the plate is valid; false otherwise.

    • deckNumber

      private int deckNumber(String token)
      Get the deck number from a token containing only digits.
      Parameters:
      token - the token holding the deck number.
      Returns:
      the deck number; NOT_A_NUMBER if the token is not valid.

    • timeValue

      private int timeValue(String token, int maxValue)
      Get the value of an hour or a minute from a token.
      Parameters:
      token - the token holding the value.
      maxValue - the largest valid value.
      Returns:
      the value; NOT_A_NUMBER if it is not a number from 0 to maxValue.

    • timestamp

      private Timestamp timestamp(String dateToken, String timeToken)
      Get the timestamp from a date token and a time token. An error message is displayed if the date, hour, or minute is not valid.
      Parameters:
      dateToken - the date in the format yyyy-mm-dd.
      timeToken - the time in the format hh:mm.
      Returns:
      the timestamp; null if the date or time is not valid.

    • existingDeck

      private Deck existingDeck(String token)
      Get an existing deck from a token holding the deck number. An error message is displayed if the deck number is not valid or the deck does not exist.
      Parameters:
      token - the token holding the deck number.
      Returns:
      the deck; null if the deck number is not valid or the deck does not exist.

      private void addVehicle(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Register a vehicle and add it to the vehicle list (A command).
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens holding the license plate.

    • removeVehicle

      private void removeVehicle(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Unregister a vehicle and remove it from the vehicle list (R command). A vehicle parked in a deck or with a parking history is not removed.
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens holding the license plate.

    • isValidCapacity

      private boolean isValidCapacity(String token)

      Parameters:
      token - the token holding the capacity.
      Returns:
      true if the capacity is valid; false otherwise.

    • newDeck

      tokens - the data tokens holding the deck number, location, operating hours, and capacity.

      private void closeDeck(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Close an open deck that has no vehicle parked (C command).
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens holding the deck number.

    • availableDeck

      private Deck availableDeck(String token)
      Get a deck that is open and not full for a vehicle to enter. An error message is displayed if the deck cannot be entered.
      Parameters:
      token - the token holding the deck number.
      Returns:
      the deck; null if the deck cannot be entered.

    • parkableVehicle

      private Vehicle parkableVehicle(String plate)
      Get a registered vehicle that is not parked in any deck. An error message is displayed if the vehicle cannot enter a deck.
      Parameters:
      plate - the license plate as entered by the user.
      Returns:
      the registered vehicle; null if it cannot enter a deck.

    • enterDeck

      private void enterDeck(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Record a parking activity when a vehicle enters a deck (E command).
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens holding the deck number, license plate, date, and time.

    • isValidExit

      private boolean isValidExit(Parking parking, Timestamp exit)
      Check if the exit time of a parking activity is valid. The exit time cannot be before the entry time or more than two days after the entry time.
      Parameters:
      parking - the parking activity of the exiting vehicle.
      exit - the exit timestamp.
      Returns:
      true if the exit time is valid; false otherwise.

    • exitDeck

      private void exitDeck(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Record a parking activity when a vehicle exits a deck (X command). The parking activity is removed from the deck and added to the parking history of the vehicle.
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens holding the license plate, date, and time.

    • printDecks

      private void printDecks(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Display the list of open decks, or the vehicles parked in a deck if a deck number is given (PD command).
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens, optionally holding a deck number.

    • printHistory

      private void printHistory(StringTokenizer tokens)
      Display the parking history of all vehicles, or of one vehicle if a license plate is given (PH command).
      Parameters:
      tokens - the data tokens, optionally holding a license plate.

    • run

      public void run()
      Run the Parking Management System. It continuously reads and processes the command lines entered on the terminal until the Q command is entered; empty lines are skipped.
